chunks: Ali ibn Ibrahim, from Harun ibn Muslim, from Mas'ada ibn Sadaqa, from Ja'far, from his fathers (peace be upon them), that the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) said:

The generous one is beloved in the heavens, beloved in the earth; he was created from sweet clay, and the water of his eyes was created from the water of Al-Kawthar. And the stingy one is hated in the heavens, hated in the earth; he was created from salty/marshy clay, and the water of his eyes was created from the water of Al-Awsaj.

key_terms.الْعَوْسَجِ: Al-Awsaj (a type of thorny bush or place, often contrasted with Kawthar)

ai.seo_question: What is the spiritual and physical difference between a generous person and a stingy person in Shia hadith?
ai.summary: This hadith from al-Kafi employs cosmological imagery to distinguish the spiritual essence of generosity and stinginess, linking the generous person's origin to the divine river of Al-Kawthar and the stingy person's to the bitter tree of Al-Awsaj. It reflects the Shia emphasis on inner character (khuluq) manifesting in universal acceptance, reinforcing the virtue of giving (sakhā') as a reflection of divine proximity.

en.hubeali:
Ali Bin Ibrahim, from Haroun Bin Muslim, from Mas’ada Bin Sadaqa,
(It has been narrated) from Ja’far<sup>asws</sup>, from his<sup>asws</sup> father<sup>asws</sup> that Rasool-Allah<sup>saww</sup> said:

‘The generous one is loved in the skies and loved in the earth, having been Created from the essence of fresh water, and the water of his eyes having been Created from the water of Al-Kawser; and the stingy is hated in the skies and hated in the earth, having been Created from the marshy water, and the water of his eyes been Created from the water of ‘الْعَوْسَجِ’ boxthorn’.
en.sarwar: 3. Ali ibn Ibrahim has narrated from Harun ibn Muslim from Mas’adah ibn Sadaqah who has said the following: “Ja’far, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, from his ancestors, ‘Alayhim al-Salam, narrated that the Messenger of Allah, O Allah, grant compensation to Muhammad and his family worthy of their services to Your cause, has said, ‘

A generous person is beloved in the heavens and on earth. Such persons are created from sweet clay. The water of the eyes of such people is created from the water of al-Kawthar. Stingy persons are hated in the heaven and on earth. Such people are created from salty clay and the water of the eyes of such people is created from the water of thorns.’”
